tasks.title: Compare weather APIs
tasks.desc:
Pick a forecast provider.

- Free tier of at least 1000 calls a day
- Hourly forecast for 7 days
- Clear terms for caching

notes.text: Compared Open-Meteo, OpenWeather and WeatherAPI. **Open-Meteo** wins: no key, hourly data for 16 days, caching allowed. Table in `docs/apis.md`.

tasks.title: Fetch and cache forecasts
tasks.desc:
`GET /forecast?lat=..&lon=..` proxies Open-Meteo.

- [x] Normalise units to metric
- [x] Cache responses for 10 minutes
- [ ] Decide what to do when the upstream is down

notes.text: Started. Plan: httpx client, in-memory TTL cache keyed by rounded coordinates.

Done: `/forecast` returns normalised hourly and daily data, cached for 10 minutes (hit rate 94% in the load test). 23 tests pass. When the upstream fails the endpoint returns 502 for now; BE-05 proposes retries.

tasks.title: City search endpoint
tasks.desc: `GET /cities?q=par` returns up to 8 matches with coordinates, using the Open-Meteo geocoding API.

notes.text: Working on it: geocoding client done, adding debounce-friendly caching next.

tasks.title: Retry failed upstream calls
tasks.desc: Retry Open-Meteo calls up to 3 times with exponential backoff, then serve the last cached forecast marked as stale.
